prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic nighttime street-fashion portrait of an approved adult blonde woman beside a deep-blue performance coupe.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult blonde woman with long straight hair, wearing a loose cream knitted top, ripped light-blue jeans, and white sneakers. She leans casually against the front bumper, lifts one hand to her hair, and looks slightly aside.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical square-style portrait showing the woman and full front of the deep-blue coupe, black hood, bright headlights, tree-lined street, and warm orange streetlight bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool blue vehicle tones contrasted with warm streetlights, cinematic night ambience, realistic knit, denim, car paint, and pavement texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic raw-style night photography, 1:1 framing, sharp subject and vehicle, natural depth, controlled headlight highlights.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 1:1 nighttime street-fashion portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with long straight hair beside a deep-blue performance coupe. She wears a loose cream knitted top, ripped light-blue jeans, and white sneakers, leans against the front bumper, lifts one hand to her hair, and looks slightly aside. Show the car's black hood and glowing headlights, tree-lined street, and warm orange streetlight bokeh. Use cool blue and warm light contrast, realistic textures, and cinematic streetwear mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted car, unwanted signature text
